title: SoftSkill: Behavioral Compression for Contextual Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2606.20333v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Natural-language skills let agents reuse task knowledge, yet deploying a long Markdown document makes the model interpret that knowledge anew on every call. We ask whether the behavior induced by a skill can be carried by a compact, trainable context. SoftSkill initializes virtual token embeddings from a skill document and optimizes a soft skill with next-token prediction while keeping the language model frozen. The resulting conditioning sequence can occupy the skill section or another supported prompt location. On Qwen3.5-4B, a 32-token soft skill improves over no skill by 7.6, 42.1, and 1.3 points on SearchQA, LiveMath, and DocVQA. It also exceeds the optimized textual skill on SearchQA and LiveMath by 4.5 and 12.5 points, respectively, while replacing skill documents of hundreds to thousands of tokens. The same approach improves multi-step agent execution: on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, OfficeQA and ALFWorld rise by 8.2 and 14.1 points over

translated_title: SoftSkill：面向上下文适配的行为压缩
translated_abstract: 自然语言技能使智能体能够复用任务知识，然而部署一篇冗长的Markdown文档会导致模型在每次调用时都需要重新解读这些知识。我们探讨技能所诱导的行为能否由一个紧凑的、可训练的上下文来承载。SoftSkill从技能文档中初始化虚拟token嵌入，并在保持语言模型冻结的情况下，通过下一词预测（next-token prediction）来优化一个软技能。所得到的条件序列可以放置在技能部分或提示词中其他受支持的位置。在Qwen3.5-4B上，一个仅32个token的软技能在SearchQA、LiveMath和DocVQA上相比无技能基线分别提升了7.6、42.1和1.3分。它还在SearchQA和LiveMath上分别超越优化后的文本技能4.5分和12.5分，同时取代了长达数百至数千token的技能文档。同样的方法也改善了多步智能体执行：在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上，OfficeQA和ALFWorld相比（原文在此截断）分别提升了8.2分和14.1分。
tldr: SoftSkill将冗长的技能文档压缩为仅32个token的可训练虚拟token嵌入（软技能），在语言模型完全冻结的情况下通过下一词预测优化，性能不仅超越原文本技能，还能大幅提升多步智能体任务的执行效果。
en_tdlr: SoftSkill compresses lengthy skill documents into a compact 32-token trainable soft context of virtual token embeddings, optimized via next-token prediction with the language model frozen, outperforming textual skills and boosting multi-step agent execution.
